\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\makeatletter
\newwrite\tracefile
\def\record#1{\immediate\write\tracefile{#1}}
\def\ptvalue#1{\strip@pt\dimexpr#1\relax}
\def\pair#1#2{\ptvalue{#1} \ptvalue{#2}}
\def\sppair#1#2{\number\dimexpr#1\relax\space\number\dimexpr#2\relax}
\def\tracepath{%
  \begingroup
  \pgfsyssoftpath@getcurrentpath\savedpath
  \record{PATH}%
  \def\pgfsyssoftpath@movetotoken##1##2{\record{M \sppair{##1}{##2}}}%
  \def\pgfsyssoftpath@linetotoken##1##2{\record{L \sppair{##1}{##2}}}%
  \def\pgfsyssoftpath@curvetosupportatoken##1##2{\edef\controla{\sppair{##1}{##2}}}%
  \def\pgfsyssoftpath@curvetosupportbtoken##1##2{\edef\controlb{\sppair{##1}{##2}}}%
  \def\pgfsyssoftpath@curvetotoken##1##2{\record{C \controla\space\controlb\space\sppair{##1}{##2}}}%
  \def\pgfsyssoftpath@closepathtoken##1##2{\record{Z}}%
  \savedpath
  \endgroup
}
% Same observation point as TikZ's "save path", before stroking/driver optimizations.
\tikzset{trace softpath/.code={\tikz@addmode{\tracepath}},
  every path/.append style={trace softpath},
  every picture/.append style={execute at end picture={%
    \ifdim\pgf@picminx>\pgf@picmaxx
      \record{BOX empty}%
    \else
      \record{BOX \pair{\pgf@picminx}{\pgf@picminy} \pair{\pgf@picmaxx}{\pgf@picmaxy}}%
    \fi}}}
\newcommand\Case[2]{%
  \record{CASE #1}%
  \setbox0=\hbox{\ignorespaces#2\unskip}%
  \record{SIZE \pair{\wd0}{\ht0+\dp0}}%
}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\immediate\openout\tracefile=\jobname.trace
\record{SP-PER-PT-CM \sppair{1pt}{1cm}}
\input{cases.tex}
\immediate\closeout\tracefile
\end{document}
